items.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He called me first to do that. I said, “How long does it take, Ken?” He said, “Three years.” “Can’t do it.”

ctx.x: I used to be like that, because I was the hard-core, black-belt, bebop mentality, and anything that didn’t hit that thing was da-da-da-da-da, forget about it. I’m not like that. It ain’t going to be like that. Not if you can do it. If you can break – you can do anything you can when you can break out of the box, anything you’re capable of doing. I’m very proud of it. I really am, because I know in the jazz special that Ken Burns did, a lot of people were hurt. He called me first to do that. I said, “How long does…
Yeah. That was ridiculous, is what it was.
